# Make Targets

> Every `make` target and what it does, read from the `##` comments in the `Makefile` (the same text `make help` prints).

| Target | What it does |
|---|---|
| `make setup` | Make encounters executable and print how to start |
| `make doctor` | Check this machine for every surface: [ OK ]/[WARN]/[CRIT] (bin/bashcrawl doctor) |
| `make venv` | Create .venv and install web-build + test dependencies |
| `make web-install` | Install the web app's toolchain (npm, always-latest ranges, no lockfile) |
| `make web-build` | Regenerate the engine's data bundles, motion clips and vendored core (python only) |
| `make web-bundle` | web-build, then compile the React app into web/dist (node >= 22.22) |
| `make web-dev` | Vite dev server with hot reload at http://127.0.0.1:5173 |
| `make web-preview` | Serve the production build at http://127.0.0.1:4173 |
| `make web-test` | Validate the bundle, then lint, test and build the React app |
| `make tty-demo` | Play bashcrawl in this terminal (JS emulator on node; ARGS="--no-hud" for the classic stream) |
| `make telnet-demo` | Serve bashcrawl at telnet://127.0.0.1:2323 (ARGS="--raw" for nc) |
| `make telnet-hub` | Serve bashcrawl as a shared hub (who/say/shout/top) at telnet://127.0.0.1:2323 |
| `make agentwatch` | AI-agent task dashboard (ARGS="--data-dir logs/sessions" for real playtest logs) |
| `make validate-contracts` | Validate shared content contracts against the filesystem (and docs/generated/ freshness) |
| `make generate-contract-docs` | Rewrite docs/generated/ from the registries, the Makefile and the launcher |
| `make test` | Run unit + integration tests |
| `make test-unit` | Run unit tests only |
| `make test-integration` | Run integration tests only |
| `make test-js` | Run the TermForge framework tests (node --test, zero deps) |
| `make motion` | Preview an ASCII Motion file in this terminal (CLIP=motion/clips/warp.asciimtn; ARGS="--loop") |
| `make motion-info` | Summarize every ASCII Motion file (size, frames, duration, warnings) |
| `make ux-review` | Score the terminal stage: log art, stage hold, wipes, overlap |
| `make test-mcp` | Run the playtest-harness smoke tests in a local .venv |
| `make playtest` | Blank-slate playtest: Claude Code (OAuth) plays via MCP, then score |
| `make playtest-grok` | Grok plays the sandboxed dungeon (OpenCode xAI OAuth, else XAI_API_KEY) |
| `make agent-sandbox` | Clean sandbox for an agent (ARGS="--json\|--pty\|--blind\|--full") |
| `make lint` | Run all linters (shellcheck, yamllint, markdownlint, ruff) |
| `make lint-shell` | Run ShellCheck on all shell scripts |
| `make lint-js` | Syntax-check every tracked JS file with node --check |
| `make clean` | Reset game state to defaults (re-hide unlocked rooms, clear flags) |
| `make clean-all` | Reset game state and remove generated logs |
| `make help` | Show available targets |
